dedupe_keys.name: jpl observations of global and regional ionospheric irregularities and scintillation using gnss tracking networks roti 2013 conference paper

description: This JPL Open Repository entry holds the 2013 ION Pacific PNT paper on observing ionospheric irregularities and scintillation with GNSS tracking networks, deposited as a 2.1 MB PDF (13-1053_A1b.pdf, version 2.0). The abstract explains that the rate of TEC index (ROTI) characterises ionospheric irregularities and can be obtained from standard dual-frequency phase data collected by a geodetic GNSS receiver, and the paper applies it to global and regional networks. Producer: the Jet Propulsion Laboratory with Skone (University of Calgary) and colleagues; conference held in Honolulu, 22 to 25 April 2013. Coverage: global and regional GNSS network observations. Access: download the PDF from the repository page; contact and citation formats are provided. Licence and cost: free; CC0 1.0 is stated as the licence. Caveats: this is a single conference paper, not a gridded ROTI product or time series, and the repository metadata record 33 downloads only. Simulation uses: it documents a method for deriving irregularity indices that can be used to validate or stress-test positioning models under ionospheric disturbance. Related records: the Indonesian ROTI maps (data-brin-indonesia-roti-maps) and the Arctic scintillation data of the May 2024 storm (data-arctic-gnss-scintillation-may-2024-storm).
